scripts.bundle:wallet: mkdir -p ./web_deploy && npm run bundle:wallet:yaml && npm run bundle:wallet:json
scripts.bundle:payres: mkdir -p ./web_deploy/payres && npm run bundle:payres:yaml && npm run bundle:payres:json
scripts.build: npm run bundle:wallet && npm run bundle:payres
scripts.build-docs: redocly build-docs -o web_deploy/index.html && redocly build-docs payres -o web_deploy/payres/index.html
scripts.build-web: npm run build && npm run build-docs
